Package com.github.crittscott.somegoogly.client.render.resolver

Class AgeableListResolver

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somegoogly.client.render.resolver.AgeableListResolver
All Implemented Interfaces:
EyeAttachmentResolver, ModelMemo.Resolver<net.minecraft.client.model.EntityModel<?>,Attachment>
public class AgeableListResolver extends Object
Resolver for the AgeableListModel family â€” the base of most vanilla mob models (humanoids, quadrupeds, and many others). These keep no named root, but they do expose their parts in two groups, headParts() and bodyParts() (made accessible by the mod's access transformer). We name those roots head/body (the first of each group) and head1, body1, â€¦ for any extras, then walk each subtree's children map for deeper real names.

This is what gives a cow or a player the stable token head instead of a positional #0 â€” the head is a root field whose own name is SRG-mangled in production, so only this group accessor recovers it reliably. It must follow HierarchicalResolver (named-root models keep their cleaner path) and precede ChildMapResolver (the positional catch-all).

For a young entity, AgeableListModel.renderToBuffer(com.mojang.blaze3d.vertex.PoseStack, com.mojang.blaze3d.vertex.VertexConsumer, int, int, float, float, float, float) wraps headParts() and bodyParts() each in their own baby-only scale/offset, applied and popped entirely inside that method â€” invisible to a render layer's PoseStack otherwise. headWrap(net.minecraft.client.model.AgeableListModel<?>)/bodyWrap(net.minecraft.client.model.AgeableListModel<?>) replay that wrap (made accessible by the mod's access transformer) so a baby's attach points land where the model actually draws them, not where the same tokens sit on an adult.

    • canonicalToken

      public String canonicalToken(net.minecraft.client.model.EntityModel<?> model, String storedToken)
      Description copied from interface: EyeAttachmentResolver
      Translate a (possibly differently-spelled or partial) stored attach token into the canonical path token this resolver would enumerate for the same part â€” the single vocabulary the picker, HUD, and exported configs all speak. That is the full slash path (root/body/head), with a positional segment (#N) only where a part has no obfuscation-stable name. Returns the token unchanged when it can't be resolved to a part (so unknown tokens pass through untouched rather than being silently remapped).

      Default: identity (the resolver's enumeration vocabulary already matches stored tokens, e.g. named bones).

      Specified by:
      canonicalToken in interface EyeAttachmentResolver

      Description copied from interface: EyeAttachmentResolver
